cohort: Term singleton pregnant women with ruptured membranes for at least 12 hours who did not deliver spontaneously within 12-24 hours.
finding: The incidence of intrapartum fever and postoperative infections was higher in women with a ROM-to-delivery interval of 12-18 hours compared to those with an interval of >=18 hours, despite similar clinical chorioamnionitis rates and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Cesarean deliveries were more common in women with a ROM-to-delivery interval of >=18 hours compared to those with an interval of 12-18 hours.
